t: Lehizzaher miggilluy vesear [veqol ishsha] bishat qeriat shema veken shello liqrotah keneged haerva
s: Lehizzaher miggilluy vesear [veqol ishsha] bishat qeriat shema veken shello liqrotah keneged haerva ubo y' seipim: tepach megulleh baishsha bemaqom sheddarkah lekassot — erva hu apillu hi ishto, mippene shemmebi lide hirhur keshemmistakkel bo, velaken asur liqrot ulehitpallel kenegdo (kemo keneged erva mammash, ad sheyyachazor panayv letzad acher). Veyesh mattirin (a) im eno mistakkel bo apillu roeh oto behaabara beolma, kevan sheeno erva ella mishshum shemmebi lide hirhur, veen lachush lehirhur ella keshemmistakkel bo velo biriyya beolma. Vekol shekken im maatzim enayv veeno roehu kelal shemmuttar, veen tzarik lehachazir panayv (veyesh lismok al dibrehem keshei epshar beinyan acher). (Veyesh omerim (b) dilpi sebara harishona lo ameru tepach ella beishto, abal beishsha acheret apillu pachot mittepach asur. Veen dibrehem iqqar). Abal paneha veyadeha sheddarkan lihyot megullim — muttar liqrot kenegdan, shekkevan sheragil bahen eno ba lide hirhur. Abal keneged shoqah asur, ap al pi shehashshoq eno maqom tzanua baish sheddarko lihyot megulleh (bimqomot sheholekin belo anpilaot), kevan shehu maqom tzanua baishsha — erva hi. Veyesh omerim sheapillu pachot mittepach shemmegulleh beshoqah erva hi apillu beishto. Venakon lachush ledibrehem:

Vekol zeh laanashim, abal haishsha atzmah apillu hi arumma — mutteret liqrot ulehitpallel im hi yoshebet sheen paneha shellematta nirin, kemo shennitbaer besiman a"d. Veen begilluy kol gupa mishshum "velo yireh beka ervat dabar", lepi sheenah erva ella laanashim umishshum hirhur. Ulepikak ap ishsha acheret mutteret liqrot ulehitpallel keneged ishsha arumma, im en paneha shellematta nirin. Veyesh mi sheoser leishsha acheret (vehaiqqar kassebara harishona):
Im lebushah daq venireh basar mittokah — asur, kemo baerva baashashit kemo (shennitbaer) [sheyyitbaer]:

Sear shel ishsha sheddarkah lekassotah — erva hi, mippene shemmebi lide hirhur, veasur liqrot o lehitpallel kenegdah al derek shennitbaer, apillu hi ishto. Abal betulot sheddarkan lelek peruot rosh, veken searot shel nashim shergilin latzet michutz letzammatan biqtzat aratzot — muttar liqrot kenegdan, shekkevan shergilin bahen enan mebiin lide hirhur. Upea nokrit apillu darkah lekassotah — muttar liqrot kenegdah, vegam muttar legallotah, veen bah mishshum "yotza veroshah perua" shehu asur min hattora beeshet ish:
Sear shel ervat ish yotze derek neqeb shebbebigdo — muttar liqrot kenegdo:

Qol zemer shel ishsha ben bipnuya ben beeshet ish apillu shel ishto — hu erva, veasur liqrot qeriat shema kesheshshomeo. Vehu haddin lehitpallel o ledabber bedibre tora. Abal qol dibburah kevan sheragil bo — eno erva apillu shel eshet ish. Vaapillu qol zemer, im yakol lekavven libbo litpillato beinyan sheeno shomeo veeno mesim leb elayv — muttar:

Ervat behema — eno niqra erva, umuttar liqrot kenegdah. Abal haggoyim ap al pi shenneemar bahem "besar chamorim besaram" — ervatam niqra erva, shenneemar: "veervat abihem lo rau vego'", veasur liqrot kenegdam. Veken keneged ervat qatan apillu ben yomo. Veyesh mattirin keneged ervat qatan kol zeman sheeno rauy lebia, dehaynu ad sheyyihyeh ben t' shanim veyom echad. Veken iqqar. Velaken en tzarik lekassot ervat haqqatan bishat birkat hammila. Veyesh mi sheomer shemmikkol maqom lo yeechoz hammohel haerva beyado bishat beraka:

Erva baashashit veniret derek dopnoteha — asur liqrot kenegdah. Vaapillu hi bebayit acher veniret derek ashashit shebbachallon, lepi shebbiriyya tala hakkatub, shenneemar: "velo yireh beka vego'", vahare hi niret:

Hayeta erva kenegdo vehechezir panayv mimmenna im kol gupo ad shennaaset lo min hatztzad, ap al pi sheomed besamuk lah min hatztzad tok d' ammot — muttar liqrot etzlah. Veap al pi shenneemar "vehaya machaneka qadosh velo yireh beka vego'", umachanehu shel adam hu d' ammot mikkol tzad kemo sheyyitbaer besiman a"t, mikkol maqom kevan sheomra tora "velo yireh beka" — tala hakkatub bareiyya, velo asar ella erva hannirit. Umikkol maqom im yekola lihyot niret ella shehu otzem enayv mereot bara o shehu suma o ballayla — en zeh moil kelum, shehare lo neemar "lo tireh" ella "lo yireh" kemo shennitbaer besiman a"d. Veyesh mattirin bazeh, lepi shemmi"lo yireh beka vego'" en lilmod ella leervat atzmo, shekkesheervato megulla — asur liqrot apillu atzam enayv o suma o ballayla, shenneemar "velo yireh beka vego'", abal lo leervat chabero. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona:

Muttar leharher bedibre tora keshehu arom, veen tzarik lomar keneged erva acheret, shenneemar: "ervat dabar", dibbur — asur, hirhur — muttar. Umikkol maqom en lo lishmoa beraka mechabero (velatzet yede chobato) (ki i epshar lomar) shomea keoneh (kevan shei epshar lo laanot):
